content.title: Adams Resources: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — Adams Resources & Energy Inc. AE) on Tuesday reported a third-quarter loss of $4.5 million, after reporting a profit in the same period a year earlier. The Houston-based company said it had a loss of $1.76 per share.
